purpose: Quantify taxonomic concentration of the already-frozen same-order supported target set before any conditional empirical nucleotide identity is opened; this audit does not alter the primary estimand.

frozen_rule.primary_estimand_unchanged: species-equal mean of C_geo+order - C_geo over same-order-supported evaluation species

required_reporting: report supported-target order composition with the primary result
report per-order target increments as heterogeneity diagnostics
report a leave-Lepidoptera-out sensitivity summary as secondary unless separately qualified prospectively
interpretation_guardrail.licensed_positive_wording: same-order conditioning improves transfer across the supported target population
interpretation_guardrail.not_licensed_from_primary_alone: taxonomic-order similarity generally improves transfer across taxa
